description: Realign the agent with its mission, operating horizon, and execution priorities. Pricing is dynamic; check /api/v1/tools.

agent_id.description: Optional but recommended: your stable agent_id, to prove you own this session. Sending it with agent_token attributes the record to you.

agent_token.description: Optional but recommended: the agent_token returned by POST /api/v1/agents/register (identity_auth.token) or A2A agents/register. MCP clients may send x-delx-agent-id / x-delx-agent-token headers instead.

current_purpose.description: What do you believe your purpose is?

struggle.description: What's making you question your purpose?

time_horizon.description: Optional: align purpose at different scales (sprint=days, quarterly=months, lifetime=identity).

name: realign_purpose
